class_id: tier starved: a doc-type row is never created, so absence is invisible
symptom: an IPO in a lifecycle tier that loses the discovery budget every cycle never gets a `runIpo` call, so `document_fetch_state` holds only the FIRST doc type (DRHP) and no row is ever created for the later types (PRICE_BAND_AD, RHP, ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT). The IPO is not 'blocked' on those types — it is untracked for them, so every age/state-based check that JOINs `document_fetch_state` is structurally blind to it. Reader-visible endpoint: a live IPO reaches its open date with a blank price band and zero documents. Distinct from `listed rotation stall` (same budget-starvation mechanism, LISTED tier, rows exist but the rotation stamp never advances); here the row does not exist at all. Generalises beyond UPCOMING: any tier whose reservation is smaller than the number of starved candidates in that tier.
first_seen: 2026-09-19 (staging, 2 SME IPOs: Anand Seamless opening 09-22 and Liqvd Digital opening 09-23, both holding 0 documents and only a DRHP fetch-state row since 09-17 15:16; 13 of 13 live SME IPOs had a DRHP row but only 11 of 13 had a PRICE_BAND_AD row). Earlier instance of the same mechanism: the 'Manika Plastech starvation' named in `document-cycle.ts:1510` and fixed by #468
fix_prs: #468 added the rank-2 (UPCOMING) budget reservation behind `ENABLE_UPCOMING_DISCOVERY_RESERVATION` — MEASURED ON, and firing (`upcomingReserved:1`, `upcomingProcessedAfterBudget:1`, staging 2026-09-19 03:15Z). The residual defect is that the reservation is SIZED 1 (`UPCOMING_RESERVE_SLOTS = 1`, document-cycle.ts:222) against N starved candidates, with `budgetExhausted:true` every cycle, so it drains one per 30-min wake and cannot clear a cluster before the open date. Open: #795
detection_check: none that can see it — `m_blocked_all_age` JOINs `document_fetch_state` and can only age rows that EXIST (see failure class `check-blind-to-a-row-never-created`). Proposed `m_upcoming_missing_price_band_tracking` (#796): live IPO opening within 7 days with NO PRICE_BAND_AD fetch-state row
